title: Technology Sector Update for 12/12/2018: SGMA, PVTL, BILI, NTES, MSFT, IBM, AAPL, CSCO, GOOG - Nasdaq.com
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: +1.92%
AAPL: +1.30%
IBM: +1.27%
CSCO: +2.08%
GOOG: +2.34%
Technology stocks rallied this afternoon, with shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 adding more than 2% in value, while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was rising 2.6%.
Moving stocks include:
(-) SigmaTron International ( SGMA ), which was declining by over 13% after it reported a fiscal Q2 net loss of $0.17 per share, compared with net income of $0.17 per share in the prior year period.
In other sector news:
(+) Pivotal Software ( PVTL ) was recently higher by more that 6% as its adjusted net loss narrowed to $0.05 in Q3 from $0.13 a year earlier, a smaller loss than analysts' expectations of $0.08 per share in a Capital IQ poll.
(+) Bilibili ( BILI ) was up 3% after it announced an agreement to acquire major assets from Chinese comic platform NetEase ( NTES ) Comics.
